DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

DecimalWire.description:
Exact decimal encoded only as a JSON string.

Restoration routes through [`crate::decimal::parse_decimal`], the single
exact text-admission rule: JSON numbers, malformed text and inexact values
are rejected rather than rounded. Serialization writes canonical
fixed-point text with trailing zeros removed and signed zero normalized
(`"1.5"`, `"0"`), never scientific notation.

FiAttributionConfig.description: Effective interval and common valuation policy for both sides of a Campisi report.

basis.description: Declared common observation, price, FX and fee basis.

currency.description: Reporting currency of returns, opening marks and annual cash coupon income.

end.description: Closing valuation date strictly after the opening date.

sectors.description: Unique, explicitly ordered sector labels. Include any cash and financing buckets.

start.description: Opening valuation date whose observable holdings and rates set the attribution basis.

FiAttributionResult.description:
Single-period Campisi benchmark-relative attribution result.

Replays the recorded position inputs when restored through serde, rejecting
any change to dates, basis or computed output that fails native reconciliation.

sectors.description: Per-sector effects in the declared sector order.

source.description: Source observations and reporting basis used to produce the result.

total_active_carry.description: Sum of sector active carry effects.

total_active_spread.description: Sum of sector active spread effects.

total_active_treasury.description: Sum of sector active treasury effects.

FiAttributionSource.description: Dated source observations retained to check a persisted single-period result.

benchmark.description: Benchmark holdings and observed realized returns.

config.description: Common dated reporting basis and sector axis.

portfolio.description: Portfolio holdings and observed realized returns.

FiComponents.description:
Absolute Campisi component contributions for one side (portfolio or
benchmark), each `Σ_j w_j × component_j`.

carry.description: Coupon income effect `Σ w · (coupon / opening mark) · elapsed days / 365`.

total.description: Sum of the four components — equals the side's total return.

FiLinkedSectorEffect.description: Carino-linked per-sector FI effects summed across periods.

total_active.description: Sum of the five linked effects.

FiPositionSnapshot.description: Opening holding and realized period return for one position.

annual_coupon.description: Opening annual cash coupon income in the same currency as the positive mark.

id.description: Position identifier unique on its side of the report.

opening_market_value.description: Positive magnitude of the opening market value in reporting currency.

sector.description: Sector label on the declared sector axis.

spread.description: Qualified settlement Z-spread experiment. Omit for an inapplicable leg.

total_return.description: Realized total return over the request interval on the declared basis, in decimals.

treasury.description: Opening-selected Treasury or government tenor experiment. Omit for an inapplicable leg.

weight.description: Exact signed fraction of net opening capital, summing to one per side.

FiQuote.description: Observation used to identify an opening or closing yield or spread quote.

basis.description:
Identifier of the quote experiment including the qualified curve, tenor or claim,
clock, compounding, and settlement convention.

rate.description: Absolute annual decimal yield or spread observed on the request's endpoint date.

FiQuoteLeg.description: Matched observations and opening normalized price sensitivity for one Campisi leg.

closing.description: Closing level under the opening experiment's unchanged definition.

duration.description: Opening normalized sensitivity per decimal annual yield or spread change, in years.

opening.description: Opening level of the relevant yield or spread experiment.

sensitivity_basis.description: Stable matching basis of the shock used to measure opening duration.

FiReportingBasis.description: The common return, valuation, FX and fee conventions for the two sides.

benchmark_series_id.description: Identifier of the benchmark realized return series.

fees.description: Identifier of the common fee treatment.

fx.description: Identifier of the common FX conversion policy.

portfolio_series_id.description: Identifier of the portfolio realized return series.

return_policy.description: Identifier of the common total-return policy, including reinvestment.

valuation.description: Identifier of the common valuation clock, settlement and price basis.

benchmark_comparator.description: Benchmark sector comparator or whole-benchmark return for an off-benchmark sector.

benchmark_return.description: Observed benchmark sector return per unit of signed sector weight, when held.

portfolio_return.description: Observed portfolio sector return per unit of signed sector weight, when held.

total_active.description: Sum of the five effects — the sector's contribution to active return.

amount.description:
Monetary amount, carried on the wire as an exact decimal string rather
than a JSON number so no precision is lost in transit. Construction with
configuration applies the selected ingest scale; raw construction does not.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 currency of `amount`. Arithmetic between two `Money` values
requires this to match; there is no implicit conversion.

active_return_compounded.description: Independently compounded active return, computed before projecting the two side returns.

linked_active_carry.description: Sum of linked active carry effects.

linked_active_spread.description: Sum of linked active spread effects.

linked_active_treasury.description: Sum of linked active treasury effects.

linked_sectors.description:
Per-sector linked effects; their grand total reconstructs the
compounded active return exactly.

periods.description: Per-period single-period results, in chronological order.
